subject: Packrat does not fetch Bioconductor sources

messages.author: 45b1bc435eea82d3
messages.subject: Packrat does not fetch Bioconductor sources
parts:
Dear packrat developers and users,

I'm hoping you might be able to provide some advice to a new user. I have just submitted a paper and am keen to use packrat for software version control in the interest of reproducibilty, i.e. to provide not only the analysis scripts, but also the exact same software that was used for the analysis.

Packrat works admirably while I stick to the same platform and use binary library. But if I try to change the platform (i.e. from Linux to OS X) and have to use sources it fails at restoring the library. After some investigation I've noticed that my Bioconductor packages' sources are empty. To be exact, they are Not Found html pages. Here's the content:

<!DOCTYPE HTML PUBLIC "-//IETF//DTD HTML 2.0//EN">
<html><head>
<title>404 Not Found</title>
</head><body>
<h1>Not Found</h1>
<p>The requested URL /src/contrib/Archive/BiocGenerics/BiocGenerics_0.14.0.tar.gz was not found on this server.</p>
<hr>
<address>Apache/2.2.22 (Ubuntu) Server at cran.rstudio.com Port 80</address>
</body></html>

I have seen the same behaviour on a Linux and OS X systems (see sessionInfo() at the end). Here's an example code that I've tried on both.

mkdir new.project
cd new.project
R
library(packrat)
packrat::init()
source("http://bioconductor.org/biocLite.R")
biocLite("BiocGenerics")
packrat::snapshot()
q()

This seems to be only a issue with Bioconductor packages. CRAN packages are saved and restored as expected. Similarly, if I replace the Bioconductor sources with the manually downloaded ones, they restore as well. I'm wondering if there's some option I should be using to make sure that packrat fetches the source code from Bioconductor.

Running under: OS X 10.6.8 (Snow Leopard)

loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
[1] tools_3.2.1     packrat_0.4.4-5

Linux sessionInfo
R version 3.2.1 (2015-06-18)
Platform: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu (64-bit)
Running under: CentOS release 6.4 (Final)

other attached packages:
 [1] packrat_0.4.4-4                          org.Mm.eg.db_3.1.2                       RSQLite_1.0.0                          

Thanks!

messages.author: ab0d2be2ea8dabe8
messages.subject: Re: Packrat does not fetch Bioconductor sources
parts:
Hi Aliaksei,

When within a packrat project, what are your repositories? (That is, what is the output of `getOption("repos")`?)

Similarly, what is the output of `head(readLines("packrat/packrat.lock"))`, within that project?

It definitely seems strange that the CRAN server would be serving 404 pages back to you.

Thanks,
Kevin

messages.author: 6755ffe22bd42256
messages.subject: Re: Packrat does not fetch Bioconductor sources
parts:
Hi,

not sure if that helps - but have you tried setRepositories(ind=1:5)

This sets the bioconductor repos globally so that packrat can see them. biocLite only sets them internally and then reverts to what was there before - which by default is only CRAN, which does not contain the bioconductor repos.

Best

Holger
